style: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original aquarium animal cutout for a mobile game and 3D modelling reference. Photorealistic natural-history specimen photograph with credible anatomy, natural small eyes, authentic skin/scales microtexture and restrained wet highlights, soft upper-left daylight. Single whole living animal, neutral straight swimming pose, head pointing RIGHT tail LEFT unless otherwise specified, every fin and tail fully visible, 10% empty padding on all sides, square 1024x1024. Genuine transparent alpha background. NOT cartoon, NOT chibi, NOT an illustration or plastic render, no human expression, no oversized eyes, no water, bubbles, scenery, ground, shadows, text or watermark.
species: Real nurse shark (Ginglymostoma cirratum), tawny-brown flattened body, two small nasal barbels, rounded dorsal and pectoral fins, long asymmetric upper tail lobe.
Real leopard shark (Triakis semifasciata), slim silver-grey body with dark saddle bars and irregular dark spots, two distinct dorsal fins and heterocercal tail.
Real blue shark (Prionace glauca), long slender indigo-blue back, bright white belly, extremely long narrow pointed pectoral fins, pointed snout and asymmetric shark tail. NOT shortfin mako.

Real scalloped hammerhead (Sphyrna lewini), wide flattened scalloped hammer-shaped head with eyes at its two outer ends, grey-bronze back, tall first dorsal fin. Slight dorsal three-quarter side angle showing the full cephalofoil width, head pointing right.
Real great white shark (Carcharodon carcharias), heavy muscular torpedo body, slate-grey back sharply separated from white belly, conical snout, strong crescent asymmetric tail, closed mouth.

Real megamouth shark (Megachasma pelagios), enormous rounded bulbous broad head, extremely wide terminal mouth with pale lip, dark brown-grey soft flabby body, small dorsal fins and elongated upper tail. No fantasy aura.

Real olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus), flattened oval body viewed from a slight dorsal angle, mottled olive-brown ocular side, both eyes on the left ocular side, narrow continuous dorsal and anal fin fringes, compact tail, head right.
Real Korean black rockfish (Sebastes schlegelii), stout dark grey-brown mottled body, strong spiny dorsal fin, large natural mouth and prominent gill cover, rounded tail.
Real red sea bream (Pagrus major), deep laterally compressed pink-red body with small faint bright blue spots, spiny dorsal fin and forked pink tail.
Real Japanese sea bass (Lateolabrax japonicus), elongated slim silver body, dark grey-green back, natural small black spots, distinct spiny and soft dorsal sections, large closed mouth.
Real Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar), ocean-phase silver body with small black spots above lateral line, blue-grey back, small adipose fin, forked tail, closed mouth. Not spawning red.
Real Japanese amberjack (Seriola quinqueradiata), streamlined blue-green back, silver belly, thin yellow lateral stripe, sharply forked yellow tail, small eyes, short dorsal fins.
Real brown croaker (Miichthys miiuy), long grey-bronze body, slightly arched back, warm silver belly, two connected dorsal fin sections, rounded angular tail.
Real striped jack (Pseudocaranx dentex), silver-blue compressed deep body, yellow side stripe and yellow fins, strongly forked yellow tail, characteristic dark spot above pectoral-fin base.
